text: PTC Tool Search 是面向 DeepSeek Harness PTC agent 的工具发现插件。它在新建的 PTC agent 上注册 tool_search，让 agent 通过名称或能力关键词查找工具，并在后续模型请求中逐步加载选中的工具。搜索结果数量和描述长度可配置，查询会做长度和数量校验，匹配采用本地词项排序。适合希望减少初始工具定义、按任务选择工具的 PTC 使用场景；代码未要求额外账号或密钥。

PTC Tool Search adds on-demand discovery to DeepSeek Harness PTC agents. They search tools by name or capability keywords, then load selected tools on the next request. Local ranking validates queries and bounds results. No extra account or API key is required.
想让 PTC agent 只在需要时查看并加载工具。
如何通过工具名称搜索 Harness 里可用的工具？
希望按终端或图像生成这样的能力关键词挑选工具。
怎样减少 PTC agent 初始收到的工具定义？
我想限制每次工具搜索返回的数量和描述长度。
让不同的 PTC agent 分别记录自己选中的工具。
How can a PTC agent discover tools only when a task needs them?
I want to search Harness tools by name or capability and load a match later.
PTC Tool Search 的功能「按需搜索工具」：PTC agent 可在 run_code 流程中调用 tool_search，按精确工具名或描述关键词检索目录，并获取数量受限的匹配项。
PTC Tool Search 的功能「逐 agent 加载选择」：搜索命中后将可用工具加入该 agent 的选择集合，并更新其工具限制；新选择在后续模型请求的 SDK 中生效。
PTC Tool Search 的功能「查询边界校验」：插件校验查询对象、去除首尾空白，并限制查询长度和结果数量；无效参数会抛出错误。
PTC Tool Search 的功能「按关键词排序」：搜索对工具名和描述中的词项进行本地匹配计分，精确名称优先，同分时按名称排序，不发送远程请求。

@hrygo/dsh-ptc-tool-search README · Repeated live results：Measured on 2026-10-18: macOS ARM64, Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2, CLIProxyAPI Responses. **3 runs per model per group: 12 new sessions, 48 turns and 12 real image generations.** Identical four-turn prompts cover JSON reading, terminal execution, result writing, tool-free recall, image generation and file readback. A uses the full PTC SDK; B enables this plugin. Values below are means per complete four-turn session.

@hrygo/dsh-ptc-tool-search README · Repeated live results：| Model | Input tokens A → B | Input reduction | Output tokens A → B | Active seconds A → B | Workflow completion A / B |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| GPT 6.1 Sol | 153,825.0 → 74,669.7 | **51.46%** | 814.3 → 1,161.0 | 48.01 → 64.44 | 3/3 · 3/3 |
| Muse Spark 1.3 | 193,155.3 → 96,569.0 | **50.00%** | 4,173.3 → 3,728.0 | 45.93 → 43.10 | 3/3 · 3/3 |

@hrygo/dsh-ptc-tool-search README · Repeated live results：Uncached input increased: GPT 6.1 Sol: 23,521.0 → 31,405.7 (+33.52%); Muse Spark 1.3: 25,761.0 → 31,464.0 (+22.14%). These results do not establish billing savings.

Input includes cache reads/writes, searches and retries. Output counts conversation-model tokens; the image service does not expose its own token usage. Active time includes tools and image generation, excluding gaps between user prompts. **Actual charges: not reported**, never treated as zero; no billing reduction is claimed.

@hrygo/dsh-ptc-tool-search README · Repeated live results：The initial SDK shrank from **35 definitions to 2**; mean first-request input fell **80.27–80.79%**. Both groups expose only `run_code` at the API level. Discovery adds round trips: mean model requests were GPT 6.1 Sol: 7.0 → 11.7; Muse Spark 1.3: 8.0 → 12.0. Output and latency need not decrease, and the SDK grows as tools accumulate. GPT had no tool errors; Muse A/B had 4/3 recoverable errors respectively, all retried to completion and included.

@hrygo/dsh-ptc-tool-search README · Repeated live results：**Image dimensions:** every call requested `1024x1024`, returned GPT 6.1 Sol: 1254×1254 (n=6); Muse Spark 1.3: 1536×1024 (n=6); exact size matches: **0/12**. Workflow success covers tool execution, arithmetic, recall and image artifacts, not requested-size compliance. Compare A/B within each model, not image speed across models.

@hrygo/dsh-ptc-tool-search README · Repeated live results：This is a small repeated sample of one fixed workflow. See the [per-run report, method and limitations](docs/benchmark-2026-10-18.md) and [auditable data](docs/benchmark-2026-10-18.json) for means, medians and ranges.

@hrygo/dsh-ptc-tool-search README · Install：Use Harness **Plugins → Add plugin**, then enter `github:hrygo/dsh-ptc-tool-search#v0.1.1`, or use the official CLI:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:hrygo/dsh-ptc-tool-search#v0.1.1
```

@hrygo/dsh-ptc-tool-search README · Install：For an immutable installation, replace `v0.1.1` with the full commit SHA in the [release notes](https://github.com/hrygo/dsh-ptc-tool-search/releases/tag/v0.1.1). The release also provides a tarball and SHA-256 checksum. Download and verify them, then install with `dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./hrygo-dsh-ptc-tool-search-0.1.1.tgz`.

@hrygo/dsh-ptc-tool-search README · Install：This package ships executable ESM JavaScript: no compilation, dependencies, `prepare` script or build-script permission is needed. Restart Desktop after replacing an installed version, then create a PTC session. Remove a previous local development installation first; only one `tool_search` plugin may be enabled.

@hrygo/dsh-ptc-tool-search README · Install：Distribution follows the official [package and install guide](https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/en/develop/basic/publish). This package is not currently published to npm.

@hrygo/dsh-ptc-tool-search README · Use：End that `run_code`. On the next model request Harness regenerates the SDK with the selected tool; call `tools.bash` in another `run_code`. Print or return the search result once. Prefer exact callable names and `limit:1`; short English capability keywords also work. Search uses deterministic lexical matching, without network calls or embeddings.

@hrygo/dsh-ptc-tool-search README · Use：Selections accumulate for each live agent. Recreated agents, including after restart or resume, discover again. Existing live agents at installation retain their previous surface. Tools registered after agent creation need a new agent to enter its catalog. Standard/native mode is unaffected. Other policy restrictions remain enforced; discovery cannot grant an excluded capability.

@hrygo/dsh-ptc-tool-search README · Configuration and rollback：The bundle inserts row `ptc-tool-search`. Configure it through Harness plugin configuration:

| Key | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `true` | Enable discovery for new PTC agents. |
| `maxResults` | `3` | Maximum results accepted by a search call; positive integer. |
| `maxQueryChars` | `256` | Maximum query length; positive integer. |
| `maxDescriptionChars` | `160` | Search result description length; positive integer. |

@hrygo/dsh-ptc-tool-search README · Configuration and rollback：The selected SDK retains full tool definitions. Search adds a model round trip; broad queries can load unnecessary definitions. As tools are selected, the SDK grows.

Disable or uninstall **PTC Tool Search** in Plugin Manager and create a new PTC session to restore full SDK visibility. No app or proxy changes are required.

@hrygo/dsh-ptc-tool-search README · Verification：```sh
npm test
npm run check
npm pack --dry-run
```

Nine tests cover ranking, bounds, scope isolation, policy intersection, unload and recreation. Local macOS ARM64 acceptance on 2026-10-18 verified GPT 6.1 Sol and Muse Spark 1.3 over CLIProxyAPI Responses, including terminal calls, follow-up memory and image generation. See [acceptance details](docs/validation.md), including image attachment and file checks.

@hrygo/dsh-ptc-tool-search README · Verification：No runtime dependencies, credential handling, install scripts, prompt rewriting or custom persistent session events are added. Harness owns SDK generation, guarded tool dispatch, approvals and logging.
